subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` use bounded reattach-first recovery before its current isolated embedded fallback for accepted Gateway disconnects, and what must happen when recovery remains ambiguous?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive CLI behavior choice involving result timing, streaming, duplicate tool/model effects, and fallback semantics; the linked issue intentionally requested maintainer direction before implementation.

options.title: Approve bounded recovery-first
options.body: Adopt reattach-first for accepted disconnects, retain a clearly documented isolated fallback after a bounded recovery attempt, and require final-head live proof.

options.title: Keep immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Preserve current-main recook-first behavior and close or substantially narrow this branch rather than introducing recovery-first policy.

options.title: Split behavior by delivery mode
options.body: Define separate recovery behavior for `--deliver` and interactive stdout only if an owner wants that additional product distinction.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded recovery-first
recommendation.body: Adopt reattach-first for accepted disconnects, retain a clearly documented isolated fallback after a bounded recovery attempt, and require final-head live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current-main isolated fallback contract that the proposed recovery policy would change.
